_comment:
'When this hits, if a Draconic attack was the last attack this combat chain, banish this. If you do, you may play it this turn.' + printed **Go again**. Ninja Action - Attack.

GO AGAIN NOT AUTHORED: unconditional printed keyword, so it fires from the card DB keywords field. The conditional-keyword SOURCE_IS_ATTACK shape is only for text of the form 'if X, this gets go again' - this card's go again has no condition, so authoring a grant would be redundant and gating it would be wrong.

TRIGGER: TRIGGERED ON_HIT matches release note 1 ('triggers when it hits in the damage step'). Ability-level conditions are checked at RESOLUTION (interpreter run_ability), which is exactly when note 1 says the Draconic test happens. LAST_CHAIN_ATTACK {talent: Draconic} (condition_types.py:1619-1676) reads chain_links[-1]; a link appends AFTER its damage resolves (engine close step), so during this trigger links[-1] IS the attack before Devotion - and ChainLink snapshots talents at creation, which is the Last-Known-Information behaviour note 5 describes for a removed prior attack.

'BANISH THIS': DELIBERATE DEVIATION FROM THE TRIAGE LIST, which said 'BANISH self'. Verified this session: the BANISH handler (effect_types.py:1301-1417) resolves target via _zone_target_spec, where 'self' yields (SELF, no-zone) and from_zone then falls back to TOP_DECK - i.e. BANISH{target:'self'} MILLS YOUR OWN DECK TOP rather than banishing the source card (the same defect class the handler's own comment records for 33 cards). deep_recesses_of_existence_blue ships that spelling and inherits the bug; do not copy it. The attacking action card is not in any player zone (ChainLink stores only a slug snapshot; combat.attack_card is the live object), so no zone-scanning effect can reach it. PUT_SELF_IN_ZONE {zone: 'banished'} (effect_types.py:1618-1639, reads zone/to_zone/destination) is the established spelling for moving an attacking card (rising_solartide_*, herald_of_*): it routes through canonical put_object (CR 8.5.15), which removes the card from its current zone when resolvable and adds it to the banished zone regardless - and an unresolvable source zone leaves the chain link holding its reference untouched, which is what release notes 2 and 4 describe ('its chain link remains').

APPROXIMATION - REVIEWER MAY STRIKE THE SECOND ABILITY: 'If you do, you may play it this turn.' The faithful mechanism is the identity-based player.playable_from_banished list (play.py:871-873, cleared at next turn start), reachable ONLY through GRANT_PLAY_FROM_BANISHED, which reads its object exclusively from a ref (effect_types.py:4236-4246; default ref 'banished' is written solely by BANISH's _record_banished, effect_types.py:853). Nothing can put the SOURCE card into a ref: PUT_SELF_IN_ZONE writes none, and LOOK_AT/BANISH cannot scan the combat chain. Authored as such, GRANT_PLAY_FROM_BANISHED would read get_ref -> None and silently do nothing while looking implemented - the exact defect .draft-review/breed_anger_* documents; those drafts left the clause off entirely. This draft instead declares STATIC PLAYABLE_FROM_BANISHED (play.py:880-883 offers any copy of the slug from its controller's OWN banished zone), which makes the printed main line work end to end (hit -> banished -> replayable) at two documented costs: (1) the permission does not expire at end of turn - it persists while the card sits in banished, where printed text scopes it to this turn; (2) it is identity-free, so a DIFFERENT copy of this slug in your banished zone (e.g. banished from your graveyard by another effect, or held face-down by Intimidate) would also become playable, where printed text would not allow it. Striking the STATIC ability leaves a strictly under-implemented but never wrong card; keeping it accepts a bounded over-grant. Generic fix that removes the trade-off: teach PUT_SELF_IN_ZONE an into/record_as param (context.set_ref already exists and run_ability pushes the ref scope for TRIGGERED abilities), then replace the STATIC with GRANT_PLAY_FROM_BANISHED {ref: <that>}. Same fix unlocks breed_anger_* and amulet_of_assertiveness_yellow.
